app.re: ^(?=.*not in the verified index; not served)(OpenDownload|not in the verified index; not served)( / (OpenDownload|not in the verified index; not served))*$

entries.reason: A schedule file whose locator does not decode to an indexed document path is not a package asset, so the app shows it as not in the verified index and does not serve it, where v5 links the file on disk. Only the file actions column (split from the description and file names, which compare exactly) is covered, on rows where some file is not served. A separate unit is to index these files as verified package assets (shared-file request in the CC-09 report).

when.app: Open Bundle PDF (not in the verified index; not served) Index PDF (not in the verified index; not served) Word

entries.reason: The assembled bundle PDFs and index PDFs are not package assets (only chronology rows are indexed), so the app names them as not served where v5 links the files on disk. A separate unit is to index them as verified assets (shared-file request in the CC-09 report). For the same reason the Word indexes leave out v5's hyperlinks into the bundle PDF (docxText reads only the text, so parity does not see it; listed in the CC-09-r2 report).
